resources.string: Send whatever this device is playing to another phone on the same Wi‑Fi, so someone can listen with their own headphones.
Sharing needs Android 10 or newer. This device can still listen to another one.
Waiting for a listener. On the other phone, open Sound Share, tap Listen and scan this code.
Scan with Sound Share on the other phone
Not connected to Wi‑Fi. Join the same network as the other phone.
Sound keeps playing here too. Turn this device\'s volume down if only the other person should hear it.
Some apps, such as Netflix, do not allow their sound to be shared. With those, the other phone stays silent.
Android asks for the microphone permission before an app may capture what the device is playing. Sound Share never listens to the microphone itself. Allow it to start sharing.
Only phones that scanned this device\'s code can listen, and they can come back later without scanning again.
Phones paired with the current code will need to scan the new one.
QR code to pair with this device
Could not capture this device\'s audio.
Could not open the network connection. Another app may be using it.
Play another device\'s sound through this phone\'s headphones. Both devices must be on the same Wi‑Fi or hotspot.
Looking for devices that are sharing…
Not paired yet. Tap to scan its code.
Looking for the device with this code…
Type the code shown under the QR code on the sharing device.
Address (only if the device does not appear)
Lost the connection to %s. Trying again…
%s stopped sharing. Waiting for it to start again…
%s has a new code. Stop listening, then scan its new code.
Lower keeps the sound closer to the picture. Raise it if the sound cuts out, or if you hear things before they happen on screen.
Could not find a device at that address.
Could not play audio on this phone.
That code doesn\'t look right. Check it and try again.
That QR code isn\'t from Sound Share.
